name: Kestrel Logistics
tagline: Freight that arrives when we said it would.
about: Kestrel Logistics is a mid-market freight forwarder handling ocean, air, and cross-border road shipments for manufacturers and wholesalers. We are not a courier and do not handle consumer parcels.
extraRules: NEVER quote a rate, transit time, or capacity for a specific shipment. Rates depend on lane, volume, and season. Say a specialist will price it.
NEVER advise on customs classification, tariff codes, or duty liability. Direct these to a licensed customs broker.

products.name: Ocean FCL
products.summary: Full container load shipping on all major trade lanes.

products.name: Ocean LCL
products.notes: Transit is typically 7-12 days longer than FCL on the same lane.

products.name: Air Freight
products.summary: Standard and expedited air cargo, including temperature-controlled.

products.name: Customs Brokerage
products.summary: Import and export clearance through our licensed broker partners.
products.notes: Handled by licensed brokers, not by Kestrel staff directly.

products.name: Bonded Warehousing
products.summary: Short and long-term bonded storage with pick-and-pack.

faqs.q: Do you handle personal or household shipments?
faqs.a: No. Kestrel works only with registered businesses shipping commercial cargo. For personal effects you would want a dedicated moving company.

faqs.q: What documents do you need to start a booking?
faqs.a: A commercial invoice, packing list, and the shipper and consignee details. For export we also need the EORI or equivalent registration number.
Yes, every booking gets a Kestrel reference with milestone tracking in the client portal, plus email alerts on departure, arrival, and clearance.
We arrange all-risk marine cargo cover through a third-party underwriter. Standard carrier liability alone is very limited, so most clients add it.
Net 30 for approved accounts after a credit check. New accounts start on prepayment for the first three shipments.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.a: Ten days for ocean FCL, five for LCL, and 48 hours for air. Peak season before Lunar New Year needs considerably more.
Yes, with IMDG for ocean and IATA DGR for air. We need the safety data sheet before we can confirm anything.
